annotation_status: AI-assisted, agent-authored seed questions and binary relevance judgments; not independently human-validated. Review and amend before claiming external benchmark quality.
purpose: Compare fixed lexical, pretrained multilingual dense and RRF retrieval over the same public corpus; development-only abstention threshold selection.
creation_protocol: Twenty authored category IDs are disjoint across development/test (8 dev, 12 test). Bilingual counterparts stay together. Category-ID disjointness does not prove semantic independence. Fixed method configurations and threshold selection rule were not tuned to test scores.
